rationale: The replication successfully reproduces all intermediate cross-checks to <1-2%: Fermi energy (63.9 vs 64 meV), dimensionless conductivity (0.0708 vs 0.071), and transmission (0.699 within paper's 0.63-0.70 range). The peak Faraday angle of 0.044° matches the graphene-on-substrate curve in Fig. 3 (~0.05°) essentially exactly, and the synthetic magnetic field (0.088 T vs ~0.1 T) agrees to 12%. Two independent Faraday formulas mutually agree to 6%. Coverage is limited to the linear/graphene branch only (parabolic not implemented), near-resonance closed forms rather than full angular-sum conductivity, and Kerr angle taken by shortcut rather than independent evaluation.
